description: Erection of a single storey side infill extension and part first floor rear extension with alterations to the roof of the existing side extension and side roof dormer to the house.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (MD/4049-01/RM Rev A, MD/4049-02/RM Rev A, MD/4049-03/RM Rev A, MD/4049-04/RM Rev A, MD/4049-05/RM, MD/4049-06/RM Rev A, MD/4049-07/RM Rev A. Received: 04/01/2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extensions hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the  side walls of the extensions hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The window formed in the side elevation of the single storey side infill extension shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
